model.description: P(interviewed) = logistic(a0 + a1*fit_6q + a2*s_j + a3*fit_6q*s_j). Fit from simulated competitive interview selection with 300 candidates, per-department normalisation, sigmoid transform, and top-k ranking. Evaluated at mean candidate quality (v_i_bar = 0.6075 ). 6Q fit uses: geographic setting, region (with signal dilution), teaching load, course types, PhD ratio, medical school proximity.
